label: FP
reason: The user-provided value is only used in a conditional assignment where it is assigned to bar only if the condition fails. The condition (7*42 - num > 200) evaluates to false, so the user input is never used in the sink. The sink uses a fixed string "This should never happen" which is not derived from user input, thus there is no cross-site scripting vulnerability.

evidence.note: Conditional assignment prevents user input from reaching the sink; sink uses hardcoded value instead
